[image]Sep 15, 2026 ∙ 2 minWeek 31: Being Available to Meet EveryoneDear Colorado Voter, You’ve probably heard by now that Colorado’s mail ballots may proceed as usual. The Supreme Court ruled that the U.S. Postal Service may NOT change mail-ballot procedures this year. Justices Alito and Thomas dissented, while Justice Kavanaugh thought the USPS argument had merit but concurred with the majority that “officials do not have sufficient time to reasonably implement the rule before” the November 2026 election.
